title: Basic
description: page, total and perPage. The first and last pages always show, with siblings pages around the current one; page-change reports the chosen page.

title: With a summary
description: summary shows which items are on screen. Translate it through summaryLabel; {from}, {to}, {total}, {page} and {pageCount} are filled in.

title: From a Laravel paginator
description: Livewire only: rows takes a paginator. Inside a component using WithPagination, the pages call gotoPage() without a reload; elsewhere they are links. React and Vue pass the paginator's numbers instead.
